closing.title: Home is where the heart is.
closing.text: Once upon a time there was a farm, with a house, with a chimney, and a path leading to a bench, under a tree, where you could feel the sun, and watch the birds, and smell the flowers. On the farm lived a farmer who had overalls with pockets. And she loved to farm, using her rake and her shovel. She grew tasty cabbages and lettuce and tomatoes, and this. And she lived happily ever after. The end.
closing.source: the picture book Home is where the heart is, read aloud (catalogue item 24)
